payload.goal: Make sofar improve itself without breaking its invariants: (L1) zero-model local adaptation from outcome signals already in the record, proposed rather than applied, reversible, local-only (never telemetry); (L2) sofar improve, where the operator's own agent via sofar drive patches one ranked loss at a time, is never auto-merged, and cannot touch the checksummed evaluator; (L3) a release gate on held-out lead margin over the best current competitor (bench-refresh D19). Starts with outcome capture: tool errors and exit codes.

plan.goal: Make sofar improve itself within its invariants. L1: zero-model local adaptation from outcome signals, proposed not applied, reversible, local-only (never telemetry). L2: `sofar improve` via the operator's own agent in sofar drive, one ranked loss at a time, never auto-merged, evaluator checksummed. L3: a release gate on held-out lead margin over the best current competitor (bench-refresh D19).
